set.body: The generated design document and code walkthrough describe implementation details that are no longer true: a merge-ordering tiebreak that was deleted, a version constant three releases stale, and an import the module does not have. Each is the same failure: the regeneration quoted code it did not re-read. Because the wrong text predates the last release, the frozen copy for that release carries it too, and a reader reasoning about merge determinism would be actively misled.
set.title: Generated design docs quote code that no longer exists; nothing verifies their claims

set.body: The v0.20.0 upgrade guidance told users to expect every frozen wiki page to republish, on the reasoning that banner text is folded into the render hash. Only pages whose banner text actually changed get a new hash, and the change affected plan pages alone: eighteen republished, not the whole site. Someone following the note could reasonably think a publish had failed. Released notes are frozen, so the correction belongs in the next release's notes.
set.title: Correct the v0.20.0 republish claim in the next release notes
